pitch_angle: Guest technical feature: 'Why Vernacular Rammed Earth Beats Conventional Concrete by 8.4°C in Western India'.
pitch_subject: Guest Feature Pitch: Empirical Thermal Performance of Rammed Earth vs RCC in Western India
pitch_body:
Dear ArchDaily Editorial Team,

I am Ar. Archana Gavas, principal architect at Anvitam Studio in Vadodara, India.

I would love to pitch an empirical technical case study for your sustainability section:

Title: 'Why Stabilized Rammed Earth Outperformed Conventional Concrete by 8.4°C in Subtropical India'

We tracked indoor temperature, embodied carbon, and humidity across two identical residential footprints in Gujarat over an 8-month period. The findings reveal that vernacular thermal mass achieved thermal comfort at 42°C ambient heat without active mechanical refrigeration.

We have high-resolution photography, CAD section drawings, and thermal imaging data ready for editorial review.

Article overview and drawings can be previewed at: https://www.anvitam.com/blog

Looking forward to your thoughts!

Warm regards,
Ar. Archana Gavas
Founder, Anvitam
https://www.anvitam.com
